recovery.rationale: Scope is the already completed documentation PR handoff. No new deployment or data mutation is performed; server restoration is outside this assessment. The PR documents how to revert its document and workflow additions.

scope: Documentation availability and original PR checks only; not recipient acceptance, current production health, or psychological efficacy.
elapsed_definition: Zero at this one-shot evaluator invocation; not total assistant-turn time or user practice duration.
counter_definition: No extra repetition within this one-shot evaluation; not a measure of user checking behavior.
